This aligns much better with the physical reality of what would happen when trying to observe the region around a black hole. The dynamic, chaotic environment near a black hole would indeed make it extremely difficult to capture any stable observations of the surrounding area.

Given that direct imaging of a black hole is physically impossible due to the fundamental nature of these objects, Statement 2 provides a much more plausible account of what actually occurred.
